name: Pinnacle Internet
summary: Adelaide ISP (pinnacle.net.au), active in the SA peering community by Feb 2000 (TRIPLE I INTERNET PTY LTD (later TRIPLE I CORPORATE SERVICES / I CORPORATE SERVICES PTY. LTD.), ACN 095 209 671).

events.details: In the SA peering mailing list community (pinnacle.net.au).
No later records found. Pinnacle's own homepage was already gone by Aug 2000 — earlier than even the proposed Mar 2001 Triple i replacement — so death is by mid-2000.

refs.label: The ISP's site was already replaced by a bare Apache placeholder on 24 Aug 2000 — no Pinnacle content capture exists at any date.
The successor entity that took over the domain (Triple i branding by 8 Mar 2001; Hotkey by Dec 2003) was only registered 13 Dec 2000, consistent with a late-200
